notes: FIXTURE intent (A2, 2026-10-08), generated from assertions.yaml + locators.yaml by build_intents.py; run/mission ids are fixture ids. Written against the D1 proposal SDL (04-schema-proposal.graphql) plus seam types of D3/D6/D7/D9 as of 2026-10-08; the pinned executor schema would reject the new D1 types/properties. Not expressible in biotech-knowledge-intent.v1 and therefore left out: p03-marketed-under-mark (MARKETED_UNDER_MARK: object-bearing predicate-only or non-written edge; the intent contract has no proposal kind for an Assertion with an object node but no typed edge); r05-resolve-legacy-strain-name (RESOLUTION assessment: no intent proposal kind for kernel Assessments); e02-same-material-two-labels (EQUIVALENCE assessment: no intent proposal kind for kernel Assessments) R-30 (close-out 2026-10-09): DECLARES_COMPONENT verbatim fields moved from edgeProperties to Assertion qualifiers (declaredName:/form:); intent v1 edge.assert.assertion has no qualifiers field, so each affected proposal's rationale starts with 'qualifiers: ...' (gap recorded; assertions.yaml carries the qualifiers).
